text.tspan: The framework accepts dynamic input data across modalities,
such as facial expression video sequences.
It can also take speech audio signals
Alternatively, body pose and skeletal gesture sequences
can serve as the dynamic input.
The selected sequence is processed by the
Input frames are mapped to graph nodes, pairing with a
learnable adjacency matrix to uncover temporal relations.
Graph convolutions, multi-scale graph inception layers, and learnable pooling
jointly learn structural and emotional features.
Finally, the model outputs predicted classification scores
